 This Writ Petition (Civil) Having Come Up For Admission On
09.11.2020, The Court On The Same Day Delivered The Following:
 WP(C).No.20865 Of 2020(G) 2
 Judgment

The petitioners have approached this Court seeking a direction to the respondents to consider their application for regularisation in respect of two buildings bearing Nos.CC8/2712-U/A (old No.12/1541) and CC 8/2711-UA (old No.12/1540-A).

There is a further prayer for a direction to the respondents to consider and pass orders on Exts.P10 and P12 representation and application, as also to accept the building tax in respect of the two buildings aforementioned, pending consideration of the regularisation application.

2. Learned Standing Counsel for the respondent Corporation would submit that the application for regularisation preferred in respect of the two buildings aforementioned can be considered, and orders passed thereon within a period of one month from the date of receipt of a copy of the judgment.
It is also his submission that the property tax in respect of the two buildings can also be accepted by the respondents, pending disposal of the regularisation application.

Taking note of the said submission, the writ petition is disposed by directing the respondents to pass orders on the application for regularisation preferred by the petitioners in respect of the two buildings aforementioned, within an outer time limit of one month from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment, after hearing the petitioners.
The respondents shall also, in the meanwhile, accept the property tax in respect of the two buildings of the petitioners without waiting for a disposal of the application for regularisation.

Sd/-
A.K.JAYASANKARAN NAMBIAR JUDGE sd
